links.note: Was 31375 'Discount is marked price less sale price', which the set explicitly limits to 'the amount before any percentage is involved'. This item asks for the discount PERCENTAGE on 840, which is 31376's own worked step: 126 on 840 is 15 per cent.
Was 31381 'Sales tax is added to the bill'. There is no tax in the item at all - it takes 8% DISCOUNT off a marked price of 2000. The base for a discount percentage being the marked price is 31376.

Was 31381 'Sales tax is added to the bill'. The item has no tax: a shirt sold at 210 at a 10% loss, find the cost price. The chapter's closed set covers discount, tax and interest but has no profit-and-loss concept, so there is nothing to move it to.
Was 31381 'Sales tax is added to the bill'. Again no tax - a 25% discount on a marked price of 200. Discount reckoned on the marked price is 31376.
